note: Settings knowledge base. Every rationale says where the number comes from; sources are URLs that document it. 'observed' lists local ComfyUI prompt IDs and is present only where this machine actually ran the setting. Narrative: docs/SETTINGS-KNOWLEDGE.md.

prompt.style: natural-language paragraph, block order camera/framing, lighting, subject, environment, expression, pose, style; 30-150 words
notes: Turbo has no usable negative prompt: the Studio graphs feed the positive conditioning through ConditioningZeroOut, so negative text is ignored
danbooru quality soup does not help except where a LoRA was trained on tags (Niji Sweet Spot)
trigger position follows the LoRA card: Niji Sweet Spot and NIJISIS at the start, fal style triggers at the end of a short prompt
no ModelSampling* node belongs in these graphs; the Krea 2 loader already applies shift 1.15
FreeU, PAG and RescaleCFG do nothing useful at cfg 1

axes.rationale: Turbo is distilled for 8 steps and most Krea 2 LoRA cards quote 8; the BArtstyle card quotes 12 and the owner's target image used 15. Cost scales hard: a local 15-step 768x1152 probe took 986.6 s against 188.7 s for an 8-step 512x768 run, so auditions belong at 4-8 steps.
observed: d7bd3104-f348-46e6-811e-3b1d918c75c3 (4 steps with the 4-step distill LoRA @0.85, 270.9 s, quality on par)

axes.rationale: euler is the ComfyUI tutorial default; euler_ancestral is what the Niji Sweet Spot card and the owner's target image use; er_sde is the setting quoted on the koukouya and Fantasy Impressions cards.
observed: er_sde at 4 steps: af080638-403f-41d4-87c2-4d821f299fe0 (usable, slightly more pointillist than euler_ancestral)

axes.rationale: simple is the tutorial default for the flow-matching loader; beta is the alternative quoted on the Masterpiece and Fantasy Impressions cards. karras, exponential and kl_optimal are eps-family schedulers and are not offered for Krea.

fal style cards recommend scale 1.0-1.25 and the Niji Sweet Spot card 0.8-1.5; drop toward 0.6-0.8 as soon as a second style adapter is active, because two style LoRAs at 1.0 usually flatten the subject.
the third slot is the style-pair slot: 0 proves the first adapter alone, 0.6 blends, 1.0 lets the second adapter lead. Unmeasured locally; the values come from the same fal scale range.
portrait heights against a 768-832 width are the shapes the Krea 2 LoRA cards illustrate; 1280x1856 is the koukouya card's own resolution. Every value is a multiple of 16 as the presets require.

notes: order does not matter for plain LoRAs chained through LoraLoaderModelOnly
TextFusion and NIJISIS both edit txtfusion tensors; the stacked effect is unmeasured here
a slot at strength 0 is pruned from the submitted graph, so an off slot costs nothing
the accelerator LoRA (4-step distill) is not a style adapter: it replaces the step count, so do not stack it with a style at full strength while auditioning

Measured 2026-09-12: the FP8 model loads fully into the 16 GB card; 768x1152 at 15 steps costs ~950 s, the 4-step distill LoRA brings it to ~270 s with comparable results. One HIP OOM occurred at 768x1152 after several runs in one process; a ComfyUI restart cleared it.
